data.title: Ocean Point
data.about:
Introducing Emaar Ocean Point, your gateway to coastal luxury at Mina Rashid. Nestled within the prestigious Rashid Yachts & Marina, Emaar Ocean Point offers an unparalleled living experience that seamlessly blends modern comfort with timeless elegance.

 Discover a curated selection of exquisite 1 to 3 bedroom apartments and luxurious 3 bedroom townhouses, meticulously crafted to provide residents with a serene retreat amidst the bustling city. At Emaar Ocean Point, residents are treated to breathtaking views that span from lush landscapes to the iconic skyline of Dubai Downtown. Whether it's the verdant surroundings, the vibrant pool area, or the majestic cityscape, every aspect of Ocean Point is designed to evoke a sense of wonder and awe.

As an Ocean Point resident, you'll enjoy unparalleled access to some of Dubai's most iconic landmarks and attractions, including Port Rashid and the bustling Central Canal Pool and promenade. With its prime location and luxurious amenities, Ocean Point offers the perfect blend of urban convenience and natural beauty. Experience the epitome of coastal living at Emaar Ocean Point Mina Rashid. Elevate your lifestyle and discover a new level of luxury living at Ocean Point.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points

  • Proximity to Attractions: Situated moments away from exquisite dining options, retail outlets, cultural, shopping, and leisure destinations, Ocean Point Emaar ensures a vibrant lifestyle for its residents.
  • Contemporary Residential Oasis: Designed as a modern-day haven, Ocean Point Emaar merges tranquility with excitement, offering serene surroundings along with easy access to nearby attractions.
  • Elegance and Style: Each residence at Emaar Ocean Point Mina Rashid is meticulously crafted with elegance and style, reflecting the essence of luxury living.
  • Global Destination for Yacht Owners: Rashid Yachts and Marina at Ocean Point Emaar is poised to become a worldwide destination for yacht enthusiasts.
  • Architectural Excellence: The development integrates luxury living with comprehensive marina services, along with a mix of restaurants and shops for an exclusive seafront lifestyle.

location_tile.title: A Superyacht Hub at Emaar Ocean Point
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Emaar Ocean Point, situated in the heart of Mina Rashid, embodies the epitome of luxurious living with its state-of-the-art amenities, breathtaking vistas, and seamless integration into Dubai's vibrant lifestyle. Adjacent to the prestigious Rashid Yachts & Marina, this residential paradise serves as a tranquil retreat amidst the excitement of urban attractions. It’s not just a residence; it’s a gateway to explore the finest that Dubai has to offer, from cultural landmarks to shopping extravaganzas.

The newly unveiled Marina at Rashid Yachts & Marina revolutionizes the accessibility to Dubai’s sparkling waters, offering an impressive array of 430 wet berths suitable for yachts stretching up to 100 meters. This facility caters to a myriad of maritime needs, from transient visits to long-term moorings, ensuring that yacht owners enjoy unparalleled convenience and flexibility. Emaar Ocean Point Rashid Yachts and Marina isn’t just a location; it’s a lifestyle that redefines waterfront living with luxury, ease, and sophistication.

  • 10 Mins to Shiekh Zayed Road
  • 15 Mins to Dubai International Airport
  • 20 Mins to Downtown Dubai
  • 20 Mins to the Dubai Mall/Burj Khalifa
  • 20 Mins to Dubai Creek Harbour
